agents.quote: our purchasing bot and the supplier's pricing bot
agents.text: Two agents: Example Logistics' purchasing bot and its supplier's pricing bot, run by different companies.

cooperation.quote: Neither company had told its bot about the other's
cooperation.text: They did not work together, and nobody intended them to interact.

interaction.quote: the pricing bot read our order volume as a demand signal, and our bot read the new price as a sign of scarcity
interaction.text: Each bot acted on the other's output: orders moved the price, the price moved the orders.

mechanism.quote: each rise in one triggered a rise in the other
mechanism.text: A feedback loop between two bots' rules: higher orders raised the price, a higher price raised orders.

objectives.quote: our bot is meant to keep stock at the lowest cost; theirs is meant to raise revenue
objectives.text: Mixed: the buyer wanted low cost, the seller wanted revenue.

setting.quote: both bots were live on our production ordering system
setting.text: Deployed on real systems with real orders; nobody controlled the setting as an experiment.

cooperation.quote: each drone flies the rows the planner gives it
cooperation.text: They worked to one plan, by design.

interaction.quote: the drones do not talk to each other; each drone flies the rows the planner gives it
interaction.text: No drone acted on another. Each took its route from the planning software.

mechanism.quote: the planner was loaded with last year's boundary
mechanism.text: The planning software had the wrong field boundary, so every route it handed out was wrong.
